A series counts games whose IGDB franchise or collection (or name) matches the pattern, plus the games you pick. Tiers: up to five goals. A season has one goal, a reward in SP and an end date; only games completed during the season count.

XP counts from the first day of the season. Rewards stay with you forever.

Each season lasts three months: winter, spring, summer and autumn. Earn XP for completed games, the daily quiz, bingo, achievements, ratings and reviews, plus three new quests every Monday. Every 250 XP is a new level, 30 levels in total.
